A '''Bothan''' served the [[security]] of [[Colliders Casino]] as a [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] when [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]] visited the [[Casino/Legends|casino]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bothan appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
